chargedElsewhere: All 12 internal steel spreaders and locating sleeves from the heavy budget are retained. One 2×3 central throughmember, two pocketed end blocks and two ten-screw end kits retained. Other ten stations require positive direct end-to-perimeter and chassis-web ties.

section.flatWebCondition: Both return lines must be effectively supported. The central intersection has interrupted lips and requires an actual bearing/splice/plate support. These are ideal analytical section modes.

decision: Retain the one crossmember and investigate folded load paths within this bounded mass. Reject an unbraced bent end: at the low contact it cannot turn the simultaneous force and moment into the top web. Size opposed diagonal end gussets, root shear and fastener bearing on two separated heights before commissioning it in a native assembly. Real bend radius, panel service/dropout, lateral buckling, corner-splice stiffness, passive bumper support, notch fatigue, pan mounting and occupied match remain open.
